erasureRequest.heading: Delete your account?
erasureRequest.bulletHistory: All your training history, badges, and clips are deleted forever.
erasureRequest.bulletTeam: You disappear from the team. Your messages in team chat become anonymous — the team and your teammates aren't affected otherwise.
erasureRequest.bulletFinal: There's no undoing it once the 30 days are up.
erasureRequest.tip: We'll send an email that you (or a parent or guardian) have to confirm — just tapping the button below doesn't do anything yet. As soon as the email is confirmed, you have 30 days to change your mind, and the account works exactly as normal in the meantime.
erasureRequest.captainBody: You have to choose who takes over as captain before you can continue.
erasureRequest.lastPlayerWarning: Right now you're the only one left on the team. If that's still true in 30 days, the whole team disappears when your account is deleted — points, clips, everything.

erasureSuccessor.heading: Who takes over as captain?

infoSheet.heading: How we work out Best team effort
infoSheet.body1: We compare how many points each team earns per player — not just the team's total. That way, even a small team can win by everyone giving it their all.
infoSheet.body2: If a team is small, we count a bit carefully, so a few really good days don't accidentally hand first place to chance. The more players a team has, the more we trust their own average.
infoSheet.ownTeamLine: Your team: {{pointsPerPlayer}} pts/player with {{playerCount}} players → {{adjustedScore}} pts once we count fairly.
